By way of the present petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India read with section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure 1973, the petitioner impugns notices dated 29.05.2024 and 24.06.2024 issued by the Investigating Officer in case FIR No. 455/2024 dated 10.05.2024 registered under sections 419/420/120B/34 of the Indian Penal Code 1860 IPC &
66C/66D of Information Technology Act, 2000 Act at P.S.: Paschim Vihar West.

sentences.text:
5. Mr. Rahul Tyagi, learned ASC is present on behalf of the State on advance copy; accepts notice;
and submits that the present petition may also be disposed-of in the same terms as W.P.(CRL)
No.2048/2024.
6.

In view of the above, the present petition is disposed-of, recording the statement of the I.O., who is present in court, and states that he will not take any steps or actions against the petitioner pursuant to the impugned notices dated 29.05.2024 and 24.06.2024, which shall be treated as withdrawn.
8. Pending applications, if any, also stand disposed-of.
